clm-invest-rule-forward-pe.notes: Author's own strategy statement; single primary source set (shared independence key), no independent corroboration of effectiveness.
clm-invest-rule-forward-pe.text: The strategy buys only when Forward P/E <= TTM P/E, treating Forward > TTM as valuation-shock risk.

clm-invest-rule-institutions.notes: Author's own strategy statement; single primary source set (shared independence key), no independent corroboration of effectiveness.
clm-invest-rule-institutions.text: The strategy defines institutional involvement as volume ratio above 1.5 with turnover above 1 percent near support, VWAP, or a key MA.

clm-invest-rule-ma200-trend.notes: Author's own strategy statement; single primary source set (shared independence key), no independent corroboration of effectiveness.
clm-invest-rule-ma200-trend.text: The strategy requires price above MA200, enters on MA10 or MA50 pullbacks, and exits short-term trades on a daily close below MA30.

clm-invest-rule-vwap.notes: Author's own strategy statement; single primary source set (shared independence key), no independent corroboration of effectiveness.
clm-invest-rule-vwap.text: The strategy treats VWAP as the day's fair-value line and buys only above or on reclaim of VWAP.
